senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. פּוּץ)to scatter, shake out, empty.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Bikkurim 1:8">Bicc. I, 8</cite> <he>נוֹפֵץ וכ׳</he> he scatters them on the ground, and does not read.
<cite ref="Tosefta Bava Batra 4:2">Tosef. B. Bath. IV, 2</cite> <he>נוֹפְצוֹ</he> he shakes the bag out.
<cite ref="Ketubot 72a:5">Keth. 72ᵃ</cite> (the Mishnah means) <he>שתִּמָּלֵא ונוֹפֶצֶת</he> that she should receive (the semen) and then discharge it (by violent movements); a. e.
<cite ref="Mishnah Kilayim 5:7">Kil. V, 7</cite> <he>יְנַפֵּץ</he> he must shake the grain out of the ears; Y. ib. 30ᵃ bot.
<cite ref="Devarim Rabbah 3:13">Deut. R. s. 3</cite> <he>וִינַפַּץ אבני וכ׳</he> and scatter the stones prepared for rebuilding the Temple.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 10">Lev. R. s. 10</cite>; s. 19 <he>בשעה שאתה מְנַפְּצוֹ אין וכ׳</he> as soon as you shake it out (of its marrow), it is good for nothing.
<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 17:15">Midr. Till. to Ps. XVII</cite> <he>אני מְנַפֵּץ</he> … <he>כשם שאתה נִפַּצְתָּ וכ׳</he> I will dash thy babes against the rock, as thou didst my babes; a. e.

senses.gloss: (interch. with נפס) to beat flax, to hatchel wool.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 13:4">Sabb. XIII, 4</cite> <he>והמְנַפֵּץ</he> (Y. ed. a. Ar. <he>המְנַפֵּס</he>). Ib. VII, 2. Ib. 73ᵇ, v. <cite ref="N01032"><he>נָפַט</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Berakhot 58a:4">Ber. 58ᵃ</cite> <he>ונִפֵּץ</he>; Tosef. ib. VII (VI), 2 <he>וניפס</he>, ed. Zuck. (Var. <he>נפץ</he>); Y. ib. IX, 13ᶜ top <he>וניפס</he>; a. fr.
<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 22:9">Midr. Till. to Ps. XXII</cite> <he>מְנַפֶּצֶת</he>, v. <cite ref="N01139"><he>נָצַץ</he></cite>.
